How it works

Five steps to a stress-free season.

From your first call to the last bulb coming down in January.

  1. Request a quote

    Send your address and what you'd like lit, or just give us a call.

  2. Custom design

    Add a photo of your house and we'll mark up where every light goes, so you see it first.

  3. Professional install

    Our crew hangs everything and turns it on so you can see it that night.

  4. In-season service

    Bulb out? Call or text and we'll come fix it.

  5. January takedown

    After the holidays we come back and remove everything.

Questions

Common questions, straight answers.

When should I book?

As early as you can. Install dates fill up fast once November starts, so booking in October gets you the most choice.

Can I see what it will look like first?

Yes. Add a photo of the front of your house to your quote request and we'll mark it up to show exactly where the lights will go: rooflines, arches, windows, and trees. It comes back with your quote.

Do you provide the lights?

Yes. We bring the lights, clips, cords, and timers. Just tell us the look you want.

Is takedown included?

Yes. After the holidays we come back and take everything down for you.

What if a bulb goes out?

Call or text us and we'll come fix it.

Do I need to be home for the install?

No. As long as we can reach the outlets we need, we can install while you're away.

Do you light businesses and HOAs?

Yes. We install for storefronts, offices, restaurants, and neighborhood entrances.
